question: Among Marvel Comics superheroes who possess the power 'Death Touch', find those whose Speed attribute value is among the top three highest. Return their names, Speed values, and their rank by Speed in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualified AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE sp.XCL_031 = 'Death Touch'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
),
speed_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_019 AS name,
        ha.XCL_011 AS speed_value,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC) AS speed_rank
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN qualified q ON s.XCL_018 = q.hero_id
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
)
SELECT name, speed_value, speed_rank
FROM speed_ranked
WHERE speed_rank <= 3
ORDER BY speed_rank, name

    WHERE sp.XCL_031 = 'Death Touch'

),
speed_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_019 AS name,
        ha.XCL_011 AS speed_value,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC) AS speed_rank
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN qualified q ON s.XCL_018 = q.hero_id
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
)
SELECT name, speed_value, speed_rank
FROM speed_ranked
WHERE speed_rank <= 3
ORDER BY speed_rank, name

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_019 AS name, ha.XCL_011 AS speed_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC) AS speed_rank
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.XCL_031 = 'Death Touch'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
ORDER BY speed_rank
LIMIT 1

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH qualified AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE sp.XCL_031 = 'Death Touch'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
),
speed_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_019 AS name,
        ha.XCL_011 AS speed_value,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC) AS speed_rank
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN qualified q ON s.XCL_018 = q.hero_id
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
)
SELECT name, speed_value, speed_rank
FROM speed_ranked
WHERE speed_rank <= 3
ORDER BY speed_rank, name
